q: For long blocks, an alley must be provided when the block becomes _____ long or longer.

n: Remember: there is no prescribed ratio in BP 220.

q: What is the prescribed ratio for saleable and non-saleable lots in PD 957?
n: Remember: PD 957 only caps the saleable portion, and only places a minimum for the non-saleable portion.

q: Which of the following is true?
o: An alley may be used as property access for socialized developments only
A pathwalk may be used as property access for socialized and economic developments
A pathwalk length of up to 60.00 m. is allowed
An alley must have a minimum width of 1.20 m.
n: The other options are wrong. For (a), an alley can never be used as property access. For (b), a pathwalk is only allowed as property access for socialized projects, not economic. For (d), should be 2 meters minimum.
